title: 新加坡用本地数据训练 AI 医疗模型
titleEn: Singapore to train AI models using local clinical data, medical guidelines
summary: 新加坡利用本地临床数据训练 AI 模型用于诊疗，首先关注糖尿病和眼病。
summaryEn: Singapore will train AI models on local clinical data for patient diagnosis and treatment, initially focusing on diabetes and eye diseases before healthcare system rollout.
speaker: Ong Ye Kung
